title: Above & Beyond | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along prestigious Montgomery Street in Seagrove Beach, Above & Beyond on 30A is a striking contemporary coastal retreat offering unobstructed Gulf views and effortless beach access just 40 yards away. This newly constructed four-level home spans nearly 7,000 square feet and comfortably accommodates up to 22 guests across seven beautifully designed bedrooms and eight-and-a-half bathrooms. Inspired by the iconic architecture of Malibu and Manhattan Beach, the residence blends modern steel, glass, and warm natural elements to create a sophisticated yet relaxed beachside escape. Floor-to-ceiling windows, expansive living spaces, a chef’s kitchen with premium appliances, and three separate living areas provide an elevated setting for gathering, entertaining, and enjoying panoramic ocean scenery. Outdoor living rivals a private resort, featuring a stunning infinity-edge pool, hot tub, lush landscaped yard, and a spacious patio complete with outdoor dining, grill, putting green, and ping pong. A fourth-floor deck and rooftop selfie station capture breathtaking coastal views stretching from Panama City Beach to Destin. Thoughtfully designed for large groups and multi-family stays, the home also offers a commercial steel-and-glass elevator, six adult bikes, a six-seater golf cart, complimentary seasonal beach setups, and parking for six vehicles. With the beach, pool, and the vibrant shops and dining of 30A just moments away, this remarkable Seagrove property delivers an exceptional blend of luxury, convenience, and unforgettable coastal living.
